title: Add Tidepool to objective question
symptom: The objective question in AndroidAPS may cause confusion because it does not clarify that Tidepool can be used as an alternative to Nightscout, leading users to think Nightscout is no longer required.
cause: The documentation states 'We recommend using Nightscout' which is a recommendation, not a requirement, but the objective question may imply otherwise.
fix: Update the documentation to clarify that Nightscout is a recommended prerequisite, not an absolute requirement, and that Tidepool is not a prerequisite but can be used as a backup.
evidence_quote: The documentation at https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/SettingUpAaps/SettingUpTheReportingServer.html clearly states "We recommend using Nightscout." - a recommendation, not a requirement.
